follow-up time: Varied, from 38 to 63 days after initial cesarean section
exposure: Stage operation (initial CS followed by delayed definitive procedure)
Treatment with traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) Shenghua Decoction
cohort: 19 women with medium to late pregnancies diagnosed with placenta accreta after a previous cesarean section
finding: A staged surgical approach for placenta accreta after a previous C-section, which included delayed definitive procedures like uterine curettage or hysterectomy, was associated with reduced postpartum hemorrhage and cesarean hysterectomy morbidity.
mod_finding: The study investigated a staged surgical approach for managing placenta accreta after a previous cesarean section, aiming to reduce the need for cesarean hysterectomy.
